posts.title: BYD solid-state EV next year? Stella Li says one model is coming
posts.description: BYD executives say a solid-state-battery vehicle arrives in 2027 — likely a validation / demo car, not mass retail. Sulfide tech; scale tipped ~2030.

posts.title: Huawei tips 12 km/kWh EVs in 2026 — Maextro S800 rumours swirl
posts.description: At TEDA, Huawei’s Wang Chao said 12 km/kWh pure EVs should mass-produce in 2026; forums tip Maextro S800 first — treat that link as unconfirmed.

posts.title: Tesla China cash discounts again — Model Y/3 cuts, sales still soft
posts.description: Tesla’s China Weibo offers keep trimming Model 3/Y final payments without cutting MSRP — after August deliveries fell to 50,047 (−12.4% YoY).
